tips.text: Refine the Rare relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each) only for an arranged four-player radshare; public squads waste the Traces.
Run the Chassis relics Intact in a four-player share; their Common already gives about a 69% squad chance.
Bank Aya now and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Budget extra Aya for Titania Prime Systems relics; Systems is the Rare in every one of them and nothing pities a long dry streak.
Recruit with the exact relic name, like LF Lith T11 RAD, because the Relic Segment search may not list Resurgence relics.
If Aya is tighter than time, rad-stagger: refine one relic at a time and buy the next only if nobody got the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab of the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Keep a free Warframe slot open for the claim when the 72-hour build finishes.
Expect about 10 to 15 Aya and under an hour of Deimos bounties once her relics are in stock.
